strategy.name: Autonomous Multi-Style Strategy — Scalp / Day Trade / Swing with Leverage
sources: Trend-following CTA methodology (AHL / Winton / Man Group)
Academic research: Bouri et al. 2019, Grobys et al. 2020, Hudson & Urquhart 2021
21/55 EMA crossover — highest-confidence base signal for BTC
strategy.description: A fully autonomous strategy that selects its own trade style — scalp, day trade, or swing — based on which timeframe produces the highest confidence score. The bot scores 10 conditions per timeframe, picks the best setup, and only enters if confidence reaches 80 or above. It sets its own TP, SL, and leverage automatically. If no timeframe reaches 80, it stays flat. No manual intervention required.

rules: Never exceed MAX_LEVERAGE=3 set in .env under any circumstances
Leverage is applied to the leveraged position size, not the account — risk per trade remains capped at 1.5% of portfolio regardless of leverage
If confidence score is exactly 80 (minimum threshold), use the lower leverage for that style
If confidence score is 90 or above, full leverage for that style may be applied
Swing trades use 1x leverage — swing positions are held for days and compounding overnight risk does not justify higher leverage

confidence_threshold.description: Each of the 10 conditions per timeframe is worth 10 points. Score below 80 = no trade. The bot evaluates all three timeframes and takes the highest-scoring setup if it clears 80. If two timeframes both clear 80, the higher-scoring one wins.

scalp.description: Fast, high-conviction setups only. Tight stops, quick exits. The 15m chart must agree with the 5m signal.

indicators.ema_9_5m: Fast trend. Price above = micro uptrend.
indicators.ema_21_5m: Slow trend. Crossover with EMA 9 is the scalp entry signal.
indicators.rsi_7_5m: Fast RSI. Below 20 = oversold (long entry). Above 80 = overbought (short entry).
indicators.macd_5m: Settings: 6/13/5 (faster than standard for scalping). Histogram positive and rising for longs.
indicators.vwap: Session bias anchor. Price above VWAP = buy-side pressure. Below = sell-side. Resets at midnight UTC.
indicators.volume_5m: Must be at least 1.5x the 20-period average — scalp moves need volume behind them.
indicators.atr_7_5m: Short-period ATR for tight, volatility-adjusted stops.

scalp.stop_loss: 1.0x ATR(7) — tight stop appropriate for scalping
scalp.take_profit_1: 1.0x ATR(7) above entry — 1:1 R:R, close 60% of position
scalp.take_profit_2: 2.0x ATR(7) above entry — 2:1 R:R, close remaining 40%
scalp.stop_after_tp1: Move stop to breakeven immediately after TP1 is hit

day_trade.description: Intraday setups using the 1H chart, confirmed by the 4H trend. Positions are closed within the same day or by the next morning.

indicators.ema_21_1h: Fast trend on 1H. Primary crossover indicator.
indicators.ema_55_1h: Slow trend on 1H. Crossover with EMA 21 triggers day trade entry.
indicators.rsi_14_1h: Standard RSI. Below 20 = oversold (long entry). Above 80 = overbought (short entry).
indicators.macd_1h: Settings: 12/26/9. Histogram positive and rising for longs.
indicators.ema_200_4h: 4H macro filter. Only longs above, only shorts below.

swing.description: Higher timeframe setups held for days. 1x leverage only — swing trades are exposed to overnight risk and do not require leverage to be profitable at this scale.

indicators.ema_55_4h: Slow trend on 4H. Crossover is the swing entry signal.
indicators.ema_200_daily: Daily macro filter. Non-negotiable — never swing trade against this.
indicators.rsi_14_4h: Below 20 = oversold (long entry). Above 80 = overbought (short entry).
indicators.bollinger_bands_4h: 20-period, 2.0 SD. Squeeze breakout adds to confidence.

decision_logic.description: At each scheduled run, the bot evaluates all three timeframes and selects the best setup.
process: Step 1: Score the scalp setup (5m + 15m). Calculate confidence out of 100.
Step 2: Score the day trade setup (1H + 4H). Calculate confidence out of 100.
Step 3: Score the swing setup (4H + Daily). Calculate confidence out of 100.
Step 4: If no timeframe scores 80 or above — stay flat. Log all three scores and which conditions failed.
Step 5: If one or more timeframes score 80+ — select the highest-scoring setup.
Step 6: If two setups are within 5 points of each other — prefer the higher timeframe (swing over day trade, day trade over scalp) for lower risk.
Step 7: Execute with the leverage assigned to that style. Set TP and SL automatically. Log the full decision.

stay_out_conditions: No timeframe scores 80 or above — market is ambiguous
Long and short scores are within 20 points of each other on the selected timeframe — no clear direction
ATR(14) is more than 3x its 20-period average — extreme volatility, risk is unquantifiable
Price is within 0.5% of the 200 EMA on the Daily chart — directional bias is unclear at the macro level
An active position is already open — the bot does not stack positions
risk_rules: Maximum risk per trade: 1.5% of portfolio value — position size and leverage are both calculated to respect this cap
Maximum trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD in .env regardless of position size calculation
Maximum trades per day capped by MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY in .env
Hard leverage cap: never exceed MAX_LEVERAGE=3 set in .env
Only one open position at a time — no stacking, no averaging down
Paper trade first — validate for at least 30 signals before switching PAPER_TRADING=false
notes: The bot decides — scalp, day trade, or swing — based purely on which setup scores highest above 80. You do not choose the style. You set the guardrails (max trade size, max trades per day, max leverage) and the bot does the rest. Check safety-check-log.json to see every decision: the score for each timeframe, which conditions passed and failed, and why a trade was taken or skipped.
